steps.title: Bem-vindo: Daily Life - Volume 33
steps.text: In this B2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Daily Life". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I love sleeping in on weekends.

steps.text: It means: "To face a difficult situation with courage.". Say the example sentence out loud:
